text: Migration Assistant transfers files and data to a new Mac, including from a Windows PC
quote: With Migration Assistant, setting up a new Mac is still quick and easy — even if you’re migrating from Windows.

text: A switcher's guide shows Windows users how to find their way around the Mac and move files from a PC
quote: If you’re switching to Mac, start here to make it a smooth transition. Learn how to find your way around the Mac, how to transfer your files from your PC, and more.

text: Make and take phone calls directly from the Mac using the Phone app, without picking up the iPhone
quote: with the Phone app, you can make or take calls directly from your Mac or iPad, so you’ll never miss a call even if your iPhone is buried deep in your backpack

text: Handoff passes what you're doing between a nearby Mac and iPhone or iPad automatically
quote: When your Mac and your iPhone or iPad are near each other, they can automatically pass what you’re doing from one device to another.

text: Universal Clipboard lets you copy images, video or text on iPhone or iPad and paste on a nearby Mac, or the reverse
quote: Copy images, video, or text from an app on your iPhone or iPad. Then paste into another app on your nearby Mac — or vice versa.

text: Copy and paste entire files between two Macs
quote: You can even copy and paste entire files between two Mac systems.

text: Continuity Camera lets you take a photo with your iPhone and have it appear instantly in a Mac document or email
quote: With Continuity Camera, you can take a photo with your iPhone and instantly see it in an email on your Mac.

text: iPhone Mirroring lets you view and use your iPhone from the Mac desktop
quote: iPhone Mirroring lets you see and use your iPhone right from your Mac.

text: Drag and drop a video from the Mac to the iPhone to keep editing it on the go
quote: You can even drag and drop a video from your Mac to your iPhone, so you can continue editing on the go.

text: AirDrop sends files from any folder between Mac, iPhone and iPad, even without a Wi-Fi network
quote: With a few clicks on your Mac, you can take a file from any folder and use AirDrop to send it from one device to the other. It even works without a Wi-Fi network.

text: AirPlay to Mac shows videos or Keynote slides from another Apple device on the Mac's screen
quote: Share content — like videos or Keynote slides — from another Apple device on the big, high‑quality screen of your Mac.

text: Use the Mac as an AirPlay speaker to play high-fidelity audio from another device
quote: You can also use your Mac as an AirPlay speaker and enjoy high-fidelity room-filling sound from another device.

text: Sidecar extends your workspace by using an iPad as a second Mac display
quote: Sidecar allows you to extend your workspace by using your iPad as a second Mac display.

text: Sidecar brings Apple Pencil input to creative Mac apps such as InDesign, Affinity Photo 2 and ZBrush
quote: Sidecar brings the ease and precision of Apple Pencil to your favorite creative Mac apps as well. Use Apple Pencil to create in Adobe InDesign, edit photos in Affinity Photo 2, or generate 3D models in Maxon ZBrush.

text: Universal Control lets one keyboard and mouse or trackpad control both a Mac and an iPad, with the cursor moving between them
quote: thanks to Universal Control, you can control both your Mac and your iPad with a single keyboard and mouse or trackpad, moving your cursor fluidly between them.

text: Continuity Markup lets you sign or annotate documents with Apple Pencil or a finger, with changes appearing live on the Mac
quote: Continuity Markup lets you sign documents, correct papers, or circle important details in images. Use your Apple Pencil on iPad or your finger on iPhone and see changes live on your Mac.

text: Continuity Sketch lets you draw a sketch on iPad or iPhone and insert it into any Mac document
quote: Continuity Sketch lets you create a sketch on your iPad or iPhone that can be easily inserted into any document on your Mac.

text: Instant Hotspot lets the Mac remotely turn on Personal Hotspot on a nearby iPhone
quote: With Instant Hotspot, your Mac can remotely activate the Personal Hotspot on your iPhone when they are near each other.

text: Setup Assistant signs a new Mac in to Wi-Fi and your Apple Account when you bring your iPhone near it
quote: Just bring your iPhone near your Mac, and Setup Assistant signs you in to your Wi-Fi network and Apple Account.

text: Spotlight lets you search and take actions without opening apps
quote: use Spotlight to search and take action without opening apps

text: Spotlight can show Ask Siri as the top hit for a search
quote: And when you search in Spotlight, you can choose “Ask Siri” as the top hit.

text: Automatic translations in calls and messages
quote: get automatic translations in calls and messages

text: Built-in tools protect your information, including password management and private browsing
quote: Your Mac includes built-in tools to protect your important information—from password management to private browsing and beyond.

text: The Passwords app warns about weak or compromised passwords and can update them for you
quote: The Passwords app alerts you to weak or compromised passwords and can update them on your behalf without the hassle.

text: Recover a deleted password or passkey
quote: Learn how to recover a deleted password or passkey.

text: Run Windows on a Mac
quote: Run Windows on your Mac

text: Automate tasks with the Shortcuts app
quote: Automate tasks with Shortcuts

text: Tile app windows and organize them with Stage Manager
quote: Tile app windows ... Use Stage Manager

text: Siri AI supports open-ended, back-and-forth conversations for questions and brainstorming
quote: Ask open-ended questions, brainstorm ideas for work or creative projects, and engage in natural, back-and-forth conversations.

text: Siri AI finds personal content such as old photos, emails and notes on the Mac
quote: Search for a photo from years ago, easily locate an email buried in your inbox, or pull up a note you saved on your Mac.

text: Siri AI takes context-aware actions in apps like Messages, Music and Reminders, such as editing a message you just sent
quote: Siri AI can take actions in apps like Messages, Music, Reminders, and more based on what you’re doing in the moment.

text: A dedicated Siri app syncs conversations across devices and supports pinning or starting new conversations
quote: so you can ask a question on your iPhone and pick up where you left off on your Mac. You can also pin conversations for easy access or start a new one.

text: Ask Siri AI about what's on screen by taking a screenshot, then get answers, search or take action
quote: Ask Siri AI about virtually anything on your screen. Just take a screenshot of what’s on your display, like an image or a PDF, to get answers, search, or take action.

text: Siri AI writes drafts from scratch or gives feedback on your writing based on a plain-language description
quote: Siri AI can now generate a draft from scratch or provide feedback on what you’ve written. Just describe what you need in your own words.

text: Choose a Siri voice and adjust its expressivity and pace
quote: Pick a voice, then customize expressivity and pace until it clicks for you.

text: Safari automatically groups open tabs into topics
quote: Now your tabs can be automatically grouped into topics, so related pages are easier to find on your Mac.

text: Safari Notify Me watches web pages for changes such as price drops or restocks and alerts you
quote: Safari Notify Me monitors pages for changes — for example, a price change or restock — and alerts you when it’s time to act.

text: Combine multiple files into a single PDF
quote: Combine files into a PDF

text: Desk View shares a top-down view of your workspace
quote: You can share a top-down view of your workspace with Desk View.
